A-I 100.name: Artificial Intelligence: Automated Thinking to Augment Human Intellect
A-I 100.description: Key artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities and their broad real-world applications, plus ethical implications and impacts on society.

A-I 341W.name: Responsible Artificial Intelligence
A-I 341W.description: Challenges in designing AI systems, examining fairness, privacy protection, generative AI, and accountability.

A-I 370.name: Problem Formulation and Automated Problem Solving
A-I 370.description: Methods for automated problem solving requiring intelligence by formulating and solving problems as search, optimization, or constraint satisfaction.

A-I 305.name: Algorithmic Foundations for Artificial Intelligence
A-I 305.description: Algorithm design and analysis techniques for data science and machine learning, including divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, and randomized/gradient-based methods.
A-I 305.notes: Real enforced prereq text is a nested boolean -- '(CMPSC 132 or CMPSC 122) and (MATH 225 or (MATH 220 and (MATH 231 or MATH 230))) and (CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W) and (STAT 401/414/418/EE 465/318)' -- the MATH 225 whole-branch alternative (an AP-credit-equivalent code) is approximated away here in favor of its more common MATH 220 + MATH 23x branch, same simplification style used elsewhere in this catalog set for nested AND-inside-OR prereqs.

A-I 410.name: AI Systems and Tools
A-I 410.description: Hands-on development and deployment of AI systems using modern tools and frameworks.

A-I 375.name: Knowledge Representation and Inference
A-I 375.description: Principles for representing and reasoning with knowledge for the design of AI systems.

A-I 494.name: Research Project
A-I 494.description: Supervised student activities on research projects identified on an individual or small-group basis. Bulletin allows 1-12 variable credits; modeled here at a fixed 3cr to match the capstone-equivalent slot.
